in_hebrew.name: תמר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם תמר מקורו בעברית ומשמעותו עץ תמר, דקל, או פרי הדקל. הוא נזכר בתנ"ך כבנו של יהודה ואמו של עיר ובענו. השם תמר גם מתייחס לנוף יפה ולפרי מתוק.

in_greek.name: Ταμάρ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ταμάρ προέρχεται από την Εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σημαίνει παραθαλάσσιο δέντρο ή φοινικιάς. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη δεν αναφέρεται συγκεκριμένα, αλλά το όνομα Ταμάρ έχει χρησιμοποιηθεί στην Εκκλησία από τους πρώτους χρόνους.

in_latin.name: Tamar
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Tamar is derived from the Hebrew language, signifying a palm tree or date palm. In the early Christian church, the name Tamar was used to symbolize beauty and fertility, reflecting the fruitfulness of the palm tree.

in_english.name: Tamar
in_english.meaning: Palm tree, date palm, or beauty
in_english.long_meaning: The name Tamar originates from the Hebrew word for 'palm tree' or 'date palm'. It is mentioned in the Bible as the daughter-in-law of Judah and mother of Perez. The name symbolizes beauty, fertility, and fruitfulness. In Christian tradition, Tamar represents a righteous and courageous woman. The name has been used across various Christian cultures, signifying a connection to biblical heritage.

biblical_reference.note: Tamar was the daughter-in-law of Judah and the mother of Perez and Zerah.

data.cultural_impact: The name Tamar is mentioned several times in the Old Testament of the Bible, as the wife of King Judah and the mother of his two sons. Her story is one of deception, betrayal, and ultimately redemption. The cultural significance of this name lies in its association with strong and complex women who defy the odds and overcome adversity.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Tamar comes from its meaning as 'desired.' In the Bible, Tamar was a woman who was deeply desired by King Judah, yet she was also a woman of great strength and determination. Her story highlights the importance of maintain one's purity and remaining faithful to God, even in the face of adversity. Tamar's name serves as a reminder that we are all desired by God and that we have the strength to overcome any challenges that come our way.
